reference.water_anchor_status: approximate P1 standard envelope; not a filled rectangle or exact segmentation
reference.reference_mask_rule: Before viewing new candidate, manually review U/F/W/K/A/X. Existing V20 mask and 3.776 percent are historical draft values, not certified truth.

comparison_scene.new_candidate: highest existing vNN plus one; do not overwrite V18/V19/V20

camera_reported_v20.status: read from V20 report; verify against copied .blend before first preview

comparison_scene.conflict_to_resolve: V1 spec recorded V18 exposure -0.25. Do not mix V18/V20 color baselines. Lock actual new-candidate camera and exposure for within-candidate comparisons.

camera_composition_probe_before_backgrou.purpose: reduce excessive upper background while preserving P1 foreground/midground anchors

variants.change: aim camera downward about 1.5 degrees; verify direction in viewport
aim camera downward about 3 degrees; verify direction in viewport

camera_composition_probe_before_backgrou.choose_only_if: upper empty background shrinks and left tree, right grass planter, equipment, steps, rails and visible water gap remain readable
camera_composition_probe_before_backgrou.reject_if: water gap disappears, grass crown or main tree is cut excessively, stairs/wall dominate lower half, or target anchors move farther from P1
camera_composition_probe_before_backgrou.after_choice: lock actual camera parameters; reproject T01, horizontal water proxy and M02/M03; regenerate candidate mask; preserve P1 reference mask
camera_composition_probe_before_backgrou.camera_height_lowering: not the first operation; it changes perspective and may reveal more distant background

platform_height.condition: only after chosen camera proves front height visibly insufficient against P1
platform_height.group_adjustment: platform, steps, rails, equipment, grass planters, T01 connection and water level must be rebuilt as a supported group; never lift only the wall or deck

mask_classes.U: observable environment = F union W union K union A
mask_classes.F: visible foreground and midground real scene, including T01
mask_classes.K: visible far bank and far vegetation
mask_classes.A: visible sky, atmosphere, far trees and any world backing
mask_classes.X: reference UI, character, subtitle or genuinely unobservable region
mask_classes.background: W union K union A; include card pixels, proxy meshes and camera-only world
mask_classes.candidate_measurement: manual F/W/K/A class mask over final composite; use no-DOF object/material IDs and explicit world color only as aids; paired card on/off difference is supplementary

area_check.also_require: class location, shoreline silhouette and side-by-side visual comparison; equal area alone cannot pass
area_check.old_v20_status: invalid for complete visible background because camera-only world was excluded

color_measurement.valid_comparison: same observable U and prelocked matched-class ROIs on final screen render; inspect luminance relationships and 50pct grayscale composition
color_measurement.invalid_comparison: raw full-image P50 of P1 versus UI-free candidate; P1 UI and character confound the result

t01_v20_geometry_start_only.status: V20 actual geometry to reproject and revise, not a P1 source parameter
t01_v20_geometry_start_only.required_screen_proof: sample visible water aperture every 50-80 final pixels; record far bank/water/near lip depth order, support and projected edge

v20_screen_gap_diagnosis.implication: grey backing can show between source water and real near lip; revise projected contact line, do not only recolor or blur

default_water_proxy_design_start.type: low-complexity horizontal or gently curved mesh with editable M01 UV water texture
default_water_proxy_design_start.status: unvalidated design start; project to actual new-candidate camera and revise against shore contact
default_water_proxy_design_start.relation: below T01 cap z 0.13 and above old dark wall bottom z -0.82
default_water_proxy_design_start.camera_facing_water_card: historical V20 method; use only if a new no-DOF blockout proves continuous shore contact

layers.source: Blender Texture Paint or equivalent editable UV source plus packed/exported PNG; Krita .kra/.ora only if tool availability is verified
layers.content: continuous low-contrast blue-grey UV water on horizontal proxy, with sparse soft horizontal value changes
forbidden: water in front of near bank
layers.camera_depth_m_v1_start_only: historical card depth 38.0; not default for V2

layers.source: Blender editable image/node source plus alpha PNG; Krita .kra/.ora optional after installation check
layers.content: irregular warm pale terrain, grouped far grasses and a few asymmetrical tree shadows

layers.source: Blender editable image/node source plus alpha PNG; Krita .kra/.ora optional after installation check
layers.content: dark warm upper atmosphere, soft far tree masses, warm haze near horizon

art_source_rules.tool_status: Krita/GIMP/Inkscape not found in common install locations at 2026-10-31 plan audit; verify before use. Blender 5.2.3 is the project baseline.
art_source_rules.default_editable_source: Blender Texture Paint and material nodes, with separately named original layer images, masks, exports and packed dependencies
art_source_rules.old_v1_gaussian_sigma_2_4_6: trial values only; not required targets
art_source_rules.external_generation_if_used: only licensed local layers/drafts with model, prompt, source, edits and mapping recorded

material_and_world.preview_world_camera_color: diagnostic magenta or violet; any visible U pixel is failure
material_and_world.formal_world_rule: prefer zero visible world pixels; if present, include them in A mask and art review
material_and_world.cards: sRGB color texture, explicit alpha, controlled emission, camera visible; disable unneeded shadow/diffuse/glossy/transmission/scatter rays
material_and_world.lighting_probe: same seed and camera, compare opaque foreground interior ROIs with cards enabled/disabled

render_sequence.storage_preflight: project measured 15.085 GiB at 2026-10-31; enforce 15 GiB cap before copying about 194 MiB V20 scene or rendering new full image; dry-run safe cleanup, preserve old bound evidence; G0 mask and read-only low-resolution camera probes may proceed in a separate temporary directory while capacity is unresolved
g1_required: C0/C1/C2 camera contact sheet and chosen camera record
g2_required: manual class mask over final composite including world
render_sequence.dof_ab: only if formal image has clear focus/softness problem; same camera, seed, sources and focus
render_sequence.full_render_only_after: G1 geometry and G2 full-scene color block pass

decision_rules.after_water_bank_projection_failure: default already uses horizontal water proxy; revise T01 contact and curved far-bank proxy, then reproject. Do not retry V20 closed ellipse card.
decision_rules.after_flat_or_repeated_paint_failure: switch from procedural ellipse/strip source to editable layered painting with hand-directed large forms
never_pass_if: background area based only on toggled-card difference
